fact: Alleged forcing another driver off the track.
offence: Alleged Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, CCTV, and in-car video evidence. Stroll was attempting to overtake Perez on the outside of Turn 4. However, Stroll was never fully alongside, and was not "entitled" to racing room at the exit and Perez' line was normal for that turn. The Stewards considered that Perez never left the track during the maneuver, and did not unfairly force Stroll off the track. Therefore, the Stewards take no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 11 Alleged Forcing Another Driver Off The Track
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
